title: Cycle count shows Not Tracked for an untracked part and never counts it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test: part A, active and tracked, with 5 in its bin, and part B, active and untracked, with 3 in its bin.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with the shared start of the part numbers typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Cycle count.
  3. Type 6 in part A's Count box.
  4. Click Save in the count toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Part B's Total Qty and Count cells both read "Not Tracked" in grey, and there is no Count box on its row.
  • Part A shows 5 Available and an empty Count box.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Count box shows 6.

Step 4:

  • Part A now shows 6 Available (the count of 6 replaces 5, an adjustment of +1).
  • Part B still shows "Not Tracked" with 3 in its bin: it was not counted and its bin did not change.
